name: relay-gateway
description: Relay: an LLM gateway with a typed middleware chain (auth, rate limits, reversible PII redaction, injection screen, semantic cache, policy routing, resilience, metering, audit).

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p apps/server
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run build:server
scripts.all: npm run bench && npm test && npm run build
